meta.title: Eyelash Lift and Tint in Idaho Falls | Rosemary Esthetics
meta.description: Lash lifts and tints in Idaho Falls: Eyelash Lift $45 and Eyelash Lift and Tint $55. Wake up with lifted, darker lashes for weeks. Book online.

hero.heading: Eyelash Lifts & Tints
hero.body: Your natural lashes, lifted and darkened from the root. No extensions, no daily curler, just an effortless wide-awake look that lasts around 6–8 weeks.

image.alt: Freshly lifted and tinted lashes after a lash lift at Rosemary Esthetics

items: Come with clean lashes, no mascara or eye makeup if possible.
Patch test: a quick patch test may be required for tints if you have sensitive skin or allergies. Reach out before booking if unsure.
Contact lenses should come out for the service, so bring your case.
Keep them dry for the first 24 hours, no steam, swimming, or rubbing.

steps.title: Settle in
steps.body: You'll lie back with your eyes closed for the whole service. Many clients nearly fall asleep.

steps.title: Lift
steps.body: A gentle solution sets your natural lashes over a soft silicone shield, curling them from the root.

steps.title: Tint
steps.body: An optional tint darkens lashes for a mascara-like effect that lasts for weeks.

steps.title: Aftercare
steps.body: Keep lashes dry and makeup-free for 24 hours, then enjoy. Results typically last 6–8 weeks.
